annotations.title: The policies a decision can be made under

description: The policies evaluate_action can be run under, in full: every rule, its id and the sentence it checks. Published deliberately, including to the agents being evaluated — a rule nobody can read is a rule nobody can correct. Free.
name: list_policies

data.description: Each policy with its slug, version, intent, ceiling, coverage floor and rules.

default.description: The slug of the policy used when a call names none. Read it rather than assume: the default is an operator setting and can change without any tool changing.

says.description: What these policies are and are not. They are rules a decision is checked against, never a ranking of the agents evaluated under them.

title: The policies a decision can be made under
